study type: Molecular sequencing study of placental tissue
exposure: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus complicated by Macrosomia (GDMM)
outcome: Upregulation of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) and its ligands
Autoregulatory cascade involving glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit (CGA), EGFR, and GATA binding protein 2 (GATA2)
Perturbations in hormonal homeostasis within syncytiotrophoblast (SCT)
Enhanced interplay between myeloid cells and SCT3 augmenting the EGFR signaling pathway
cohort: Placental tissues from pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes mellitus and macrosomia.
finding: The study revealed pronounced upregulation of EGFR signaling, an autoregulatory cascade involving CGA, EGFR, and GATA2, and enhanced interplay between myeloid cells and SCT3 in placentas from pregnancies with GDMM, underscoring the role of the placental immune microenvironment in macrosomia etiology.
